listing.name: 4D Driving (FM Towns Marty rerelease) — pc-4ddriving (vs-sr-dev)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Races/replay/editor/music/audio comparisons; no completed full-game checks; the distinct Marty edition preserved. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese FM Towns Marty 4D Driving rerelease HMD222A disc with all 12 tracks, plus your own font ROM. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract your own disc and generate code with fmtownskit, then start build/rt/4ddriving. Keep its local user-disk save/a data. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: The project reports races, replays, editor, music and audio comparisons for the distinct Marty edition. Complete full-game checks have not been performed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
